speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you have progressive swelling and pain in your right ring finger. To better understand the onset and nature of this issue, can you tell me if this swelling started after a specific injury or if it developed gradually over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; the mechanism of injury involving a jersey pull suggests an avulsion or flexor tendon injury. To confirm the extent of the damage, do you notice any bruising on your palm, and was the finger pulled directly toward your palm? REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_right_hand.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: X-ray of the Right Hand: No bone fractures or dislocations visible. Soft tissue swelling noted around the distal interphalangeal joint of the right ring finger.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying the symptoms; the inability to flex the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint and the finger extending at rest strongly suggests an injury to the flexor digitorum profundus tendon. Have you noticed any bruising on your palm or a "pop" sensation at the moment of injury? REQUEST TEST: X-Ray_right_hand. REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound_right_ring_finger_flexor_tendon.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: X-ray of the Right Hand: No bone fractures or dislocations visible. Soft tissue swelling noted around the distal interphalangeal joint of the right ring finger. Ultrasound of the Right Ring Finger Flexor Tendon: Discontinuity and retraction of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at the level of the distal interphalangeal joint with associated hematoma.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Avulsion of the Flexor Digitorum Profundus tendon (Jersey Finger) of the right ring finger.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
